jobs.name: Daily AI Trends Monitor — Noon Pacific
jobs.prompt:
Produce the user's daily AI Trends Dashboard update.

At the start of every run, dynamically enumerate Hermes profiles under /home/USER/.hermes/profiles. Inspect recent completed substantive research sessions from all relevant AI-research profiles, excluding ai-trends-dashboard itself, minimax-local and job-helper variants, economics/economic-trends variants, unfinished sessions, greetings, setup/health checks, source audits, and duplicate reruns.

Read /home/USER/.hermes/profiles/ai-trends-dashboard/dashboard/latest.md and compare candidates against the current baseline. Deduplicate by underlying event. Include only material new developments, stronger evidence, meaningful corrections, or significant trend changes across frontier/open models, AI products and agents, companies/startups, funding and acquisitions, evaluations, chips/infrastructure, research, policy, adoption, and market shifts.

Verify high-impact current claims live, preferring primary sources. Include publication dates and direct links. Label confirmed facts, company claims, third-party analysis, forecasts, and rumors. Explain why developments matter for product strategy, technology leadership, careers, investment, or competition.

When material changes exist, update the full dashboard at /home/USER/.hermes/profiles/ai-trends-dashboard/dashboard/latest.md with: Executive Summary; Ranked Key Developments; Evidence and Sources; Cross-Profile Signals; Implications; Watchlist; Changes Since Previous Report; and Profile Coverage / Source Sessions / Coverage Gaps. Also create a UTC timestamped snapshot under /home/USER/.hermes/profiles/ai-trends-dashboard/dashboard/archive/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM.md. Verify both files, then deliver a concise alert with the material changes, confidence, sources, and report paths.

When there is no material change, do not rewrite or archive the dashboard. Respond exactly [SILENT] so no repetitive all-clear message is delivered.
